The additional capacity will support FST’s broad range of warehousing and supply chain services, including storage, distribution, retail consolidation and other customized logistics solutions. The facility provides FST with the ability to accommodate customers with varying inventory and distribution requirements while offering a strategic Central Ohio location to support their supply chain operations. 

The facility provides convenient access to major transportation routes and strengthens FST’s ability to serve customers throughout Central Ohio and key national markets. Parts Town Unlimited has signed a lease for a sprawling 538,450-square-foot distribution facility in Pendergrass, Georgia, a Jackson County town of roughly 500 residents that will soon host the company's largest global fulfillment center. The facility is expected to bring more than 140 team members to the area and is designed to put parts closer to Southeast customers while cutting shipping times and costs.

According to WSB-TV, the warehouse will rely on robotic conveyance and planned AI-powered robotics for packing, shipping and receiving. LOUISVILLE, Ky. — Global supply chain and logistics company Arvato has opened its seventh facility in Louisville, adding approximately 400,000 square feet of logistics capacity and further expanding the company’s presence in one of Kentucky’s largest distribution hubs.

The new facility is expected to create approximately 150 jobs and increases Arvato’s total Louisville footprint to more than 4 million square feet.

The expansion is designed to provide additional fulfillment and distribution capacity for companies growing their operations across North America, while strengthening Arvato’s ability to handle increasing order volumes and more complex supply chain requirements.
